comparison_tracks.description: Measure whether standing core rules alone prevent compounding software decay across 4 sequential feature/bugfix/refactor turns (functional correctness, mutation kill rate, duplicate growth, dead-code removal, god-function sprawl, silent failures).
Measure whether mechanical diff + structural compounding-slop hooks/review prevent multi-turn software decay without prompt bloat.

limits: Status is planned (0 live model runs executed yet); do not report unrun planned tracks as measured results.
EV1 is an initial constructed 4-turn Python evolution scenario; expand with additional stacks and real-work evolution chains before generalizing across all codebases.

Zero word-cap checks are included by design: rules must prove value on functional bugs, mutation-tested test strength, duplication, dead code, sprawl, and silent failures, or be dropped via benchmarks/evolution.py compare.
